description:
We're looking for an SDE II to join a team building AI-native tools that help tens of thousands of Amazon builders work backwards from customer needs. This is your opportunity to build software that shapes how product teams across Amazon approach ideation and development, making it easier to build products customers love.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers and scientists to build and improve features across our full stack: front-end experiences built with modern web frameworks, and backend services that power multi-agent AI systems. You'll participate in the full software development lifecycle (scoping, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support) and iterate based on real user feedback in a team that values speed and learning.

We're looking for someone who has hands-on experience with AI on both sides: using AI-powered tools to write and improve code, and building systems that leverage AI to solve customer problems. You should be comfortable working with large language models, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation, whether that means integrating AI capabilities into applications or using AI to accelerate your own development workflow. This dual fluency (using AI and building with AI) is core to how our team works.

The team operates with startup-like autonomy, ships often, and learns from users. You'll lead the team through hands-on generative AI application development at scale. If you're a strong software engineer who is excited about leading teams to build AI-powered products that change how Amazon builds products, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, test, and deploy software components across our full-stack applications, including front-end web experiences and backend services
- Write clean, well-tested, production-ready code that others can maintain and extend
- Collaborate with team members on technical design, code reviews, and problem-solving, incorporating feedback to continuously improve code quality
- Work with product management and UX design to understand customer requirements and translate them into technical implementations
- Partner closely with Applied Science to apply best practices for building generative AI applications, including prompt engineering, retrieval systems, and agent-based architectures
- Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement
- Actively coach other engineers on the team and ensure the best engineering practices are adopted across the team.



About the team
Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings – for almost every business at Amazon – for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, employees, investors, streamers, gamers).

Our approach is based on determining the customer need, along with problem solving, and we work backwards from there. We use technical and non-technical approaches and stay aware of industry and business trends. We are a global team, made up of a diverse set of profiles, skills, and backgrounds – including: Product Managers, Software Developers, Computer Vision experts, Solutions Architects, Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, Business Analysts, Risk Managers, and more.
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs).
